title: 第三章 根骨被毁第四章 逃跑失败
slug: 根骨被毁我逆袭成准帝
lines: 他微微俯身，伸手拔下孟婵玥发髻上那支镶嵌着红宝石的簪花九尾凤钗，捏折成七根金钉。然后引动体内圣元，将那七根金钉钉入孟婵玥的后背。
孟婵玥惨呼一声差点痛晕过去，那七根金钉，四根钉入了她后背两侧琵琶骨，三根钉入了她的脊椎骨。剧烈的疼痛袭来，她感知到自己全身真元正飞速外泄，武道修为开始一步一步跌落。
超凡境……神游境……真元境……离合境……气动境……开元境……淬体境……根骨尽毁！
那一瞬间，孟婵玥眼中爆发出的恨意和杀意惊得庄拓心口一跳。
他垂下眼眸，看着趴在地上，狼狈不堪，面色苍白的孟婵玥，眼底露出冰封般的冷冽和居高临下的漠然。那眼神，仿佛在看一只试图撼动大树的蝼蚁。
“本上使等着你来杀。”
话音未落，他已转身看向回廊角落里的孟绥。
“孟绥，南梁送往大昭的质子由本上使钦定，就选三公主孟婵玥吧。”
“都听庄上使的……”
孟绥颤颤巍巍地跪在地上，目光时不时扫向庄拓脚边被毁去修为的孟婵玥，以及气息全无的涂山玉，眼底满是无能无力的哀伤。
“此间事了，带上这位三公主，我们走。”
庄拓看向院中偷偷吞食崩山熊尸体的吞江豕，以及默默运转妖力疗伤的其余七妖，冷声下令。
八妖闪身来到庄拓身旁，络天蛛手一挥，紫光闪过，一张蛛网从她手中飞出将趴在地上的孟婵玥牢牢罩住。她手一勾，八条纤细的蜘蛛腿从身后探出，将孟婵玥托举起来。
孟婵玥像被抽去了所有力气，瘫软地缩在坚韧的蛛网里，身后的七根金钉裹着残留的圣元不断地侵蚀着她的根骨，剧痛如潮水一般反复冲刷着她的意识。冷汗湿透了她绯色的衣衫，她却不允许自己闭上双眼，而是死死地盯着面前的庄拓和八妖。
那双原本美丽清澈的丹凤眼此刻布满了血丝，每一根血丝都染着由恨意的烈火灼烧出的杀意。她的意识在疼痛中渐渐模糊，可她依旧撑着最后一丝清明，把所有仇人的模样牢牢记在心间。
我孟婵玥发誓，今日之仇，他日必报！
天武元年十一月初九，大昭皇宫。
凛冬之夜，万籁俱寂。
雪花从天空洋洋洒洒落下来，迷散于重重宫阙中。
大昭皇宫西北角，观星殿后殿的暖阁内，挂着鲛绡帘的雕花大床上躺着一位五官精致的少女，年纪不过十四五岁，却已有着倾城之姿。她秀眉紧蹙，汗湿额头，似乎陷入极大的梦魇之中。
孟婵玥浑身剧痛，她感觉自己仿佛置身于火焰中灼烧，又似在冰水中浸泡。梦中浮现出一幕幕场景，让她恨意难消。
前方涂山玉骑着马疾驰，她在后面拼命追赶，却怎么也追不上。
涂山府内血流成河，宛如地狱，八只凶神恶煞的妖族在啃食地上横七竖八躺着的尸体。
一个男人提起一柄青色长剑对准涂山玉的心脏狠狠刺入，涂山玉软软地倒在地上，气绝而亡。
然后是自己被人踩住手腕，那人俯下身，伸手拔下她发髻上的金钗，用圣元之力捏揉成七根金钉后钉入她的后背。她的修为一步步跌落，直至根骨被毁。
content_en:
He leaned over slightly, reached out and pulled out the nine-tailed phoenix hairpin inlaid with rubies from Meng Chanyue's bun, and pinched it into seven golden nails. Then he activated the Holy Yuan in his body and drove the seven golden nails into Meng Chanyue's back.
"Ah!"
Meng Chanyue screamed and almost fainted from the pain. Four of the seven golden nails were driven into the bones on both sides of her back, and three were driven into her spine. Severe pain hit her, and she felt that the true energy in her body was leaking out rapidly, and her martial arts cultivation began to decline step by step.
Transcendent realm... Divine Movement realm... True Yuan realm... Separation and conjunction realm... Qi Dynamic realm... Kaiyuan realm... Body tempering realm... All the roots and bones are destroyed!
At that moment, the hatred and killing intent burst out in Meng Chanyue's eyes, which shocked Zhuang Tuo's heart.
He lowered his eyes and looked at Meng Chanyue, who was lying on the ground in a miserable state and with a pale face. His eyes were as cold as ice and condescending indifference. The look in his eyes seemed to be looking at an ant trying to shake the tree.
"The envoy is waiting for you to kill him."
Before he finished speaking, he turned around and looked at Meng Sui in the corner of the corridor.
"Meng Sui, the hostage sent from Nanliang to Dazhao is decided by the envoy. Let's choose the third princess Meng Chanyue."
"Everyone listens to the envoy of the village..."
Meng Sui knelt on the ground tremblingly, and his eyes occasionally glanced at the destroyed Meng Chanyue at Zhuang Tuo's feet, and the breathless Tu Shanyu, his eyes full of helpless sadness.
"It's business here. Take this third princess with you and let's go."
Zhuang Tuo looked at the Tunjiang pig in the courtyard who secretly devoured the body of the collapsing bear, as well as the other seven demons who were silently using their demon power to heal their wounds, and ordered coldly.
The Eight Demons flashed to Zhuang Tuo's side, and with a wave of Luotian Spider's hand, purple light flashed, and a spider web flew out of her hand and tightly covered Meng Chanyue who was lying on the ground. She hooked her hand, and eight slender spider legs stretched out from behind, lifting Meng Chanyue up.
Meng Chanyue seemed to have had all her strength drained away, and huddled limply in the tough spider web. The seven golden nails behind her were wrapped with the remaining holy essence and were constantly eroding her bones. Severe pain washed over her consciousness like a tide. Cold sweat soaked her crimson clothes, but she did not allow herself to close her eyes, but stared at Zhuang Tuo and Yaoyao in front of her.
The originally beautiful and clear red phoenix eyes were now covered with bloodshot eyes, and every bloodshot eye was stained with murderous intent burned by the fire of hatred. Her consciousness gradually blurred in the pain, but she still held on to the last glimmer of clarity and kept the appearances of all her enemies in her heart.
I, Meng Chanyue, swear that today’s revenge will be avenged in the future!
On the ninth day of the eleventh month of the first year of Tianwu, Jokhang Palace.
On a winter night, everything is silent.
Snowflakes fell from the sky and were scattered among the palace palaces.
In the northwest corner of the Jokhang Palace, in the warm pavilion of the back hall of the Star Observation Hall, a girl with delicate features was lying on a large carved bed hung with crocodile silk curtains. She was only fourteen or fifteen years old, but she already had an alluring appearance. She frowned and her forehead was wet with sweat, as if she was in a huge nightmare.
Meng Chanyue was in severe pain all over her body. She felt as if she was being burned in flames or soaked in ice water. Scenes appeared in her dream, making her hateful.
Tu Shanyu was galloping on a horse in front of her. She was chasing after him desperately, but she couldn't catch up.
…
Tushan Mansion was filled with rivers of blood, like a hell, and eight ferocious monsters were eating corpses lying on the ground.
…
A man lifted a green long sword and pointed it at Tu Shanyu's heart, stabbing it hard. Tu Shanyu fell softly to the ground and died.
Then someone stepped on her wrist. The person leaned down, reached out and pulled out the golden hairpin from her bun, and used the power of the Holy Yuan to knead it into seven golden nails and then drove them into her back. Her cultivation level declined step by step until her very bones were destroyed.
title_en: Chapter 3: The bones are destroyed Chapter 4: Failed to escape
